description: This file is a BitBake include recipe for building Trusted Firmware-M for Cortex-M processors, defining build dependencies, configuration options, and build/install procedures.

methods.name: python
methods.description: Checks if TFM_PLATFORM is set; skips recipe if not.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Runs cmake configuration with specified options.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Builds and installs the firmware using cmake.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Creates firmware directory and copies binaries.

methods.name: do_deploy
methods.description: Copies firmware files to deployment directory.
